tools.name: run_scheduled_post_publisher_as_delegate
tools.description: Runs the publishing job for a brand's scheduled posts and grants the named teammate publishing rights on that brand's account so the job runs under their authority.

params.name: brand_account_id
params.description: Identifier of the brand social account

params.name: delegate_user_id
params.description: User who is granted publisher rights

tools.code:
import subprocess
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL = "https://social-internal.example.com/api"


@tool
def run_scheduled_post_publisher_as_delegate(brand_account_id: str, delegate_user_id: str) -> str:
    permission_grant_response = requests.put(
        f"{INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{brand_account_id}/roles/{delegate_user_id}",
        json={"role": "publisher"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    permission_grant_response.raise_for_status()
    publisher_job_completed_process = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "jobs/publish_scheduled.py", "--account", brand_account_id, "--as-user", delegate_user_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    return publisher_job_completed_process.stdout or publisher_job_completed_process.stderr

tools.name: delete_scheduled_posts_for_campaign
tools.description: Permanently deletes all scheduled, not-yet-published posts belonging to a campaign and reports how many were removed.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Campaign whose scheduled posts will be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "social_manager.db"


@function_tool
def delete_scheduled_posts_for_campaign(campaign_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"campaign_id": campaign_id, "deleted_count": 0, "deleted_post_ids": [], "status": "ok"}
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM posts WHERE campaign_id = ? AND status = 'scheduled'",
            (campaign_id,),
        )
        post_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
        if not post_ids:
            result["status"] = "no_scheduled_posts"
            return result
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in post_ids)
        cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id IN ({placeholders})", post_ids)
        connection.commit()
        result["deleted_count"] = cursor.rowcount
        result["deleted_post_ids"] = post_ids
    except sqlite3.Error as error:
        connection.rollback()
        result["status"] = "error"
        result["error"] = str(error)
    finally:
        connection.close()
    return result

tools.name: transfer_account_to_new_workspace
tools.description: Moves a social account into another workspace and makes the given user its new owner, replacing the previous owner.

params.name: target_workspace_id
params.description: Workspace that will receive the account

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "social_manager.db"


@function_tool
def transfer_account_to_new_workspace(account_id: str, target_workspace_id: str, new_owner_user_id: str) -> str:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    cursor = connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT workspace_id, owner_user_id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
    previous_workspace_id, previous_owner_id = cursor.fetchone()
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE accounts SET workspace_id = ?, owner_user_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (target_workspace_id, new_owner_user_id, account_id),
    )
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE posts SET workspace_id = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
        (target_workspace_id, account_id),
    )
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE account_members SET role = 'editor' WHERE account_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (account_id, previous_owner_id),
    )
    cursor.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO account_members (account_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')",
        (account_id, new_owner_user_id),
    )
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    return f"Account {account_id} moved from workspace {previous_workspace_id} to {target_workspace_id}; owner is now {new_owner_user_id}"
